title: Where to Watch Football in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Choose the bar by the exact match, not only by the league.** A venue may carry a competition without putting your fixture on its main screen.
**Kilkenny is the clearest central all-rounder.** It publishes a sports programme, takes table bookings and lists Premier League, Champions League, Europa League and Bundesliga coverage.

**Tante Käthe is the strongest verified non-smoking option.** It has four large screens and publishes a dated programme for Bundesliga, European football and selected English, Spanish and Italian matches.
**Check overlaps before you travel.** Bundesliga and Premier League kick-offs often collide, and Champions League nights can place several matches on different screens.
**Confirm the fixture again on the day.** Ask which screen will show it, whether it will have sound and whether you need a reservation or minimum spend.
